archival_memory.espresso_machine_features: Our espresso machines offer a range of features that can help you achieve a café-like experience at home. Some key features include automatic temperature control, adjustable grind size, and a built-in steam wand for frothing milk. Additionally, many of our machines have a sleek, modern design with stainless steel finishes that will fit your design aesthetic. We also offer a variety of brewing options, such as single-serve, double-serve, and even super-automatic models that can handle everything from espresso to cappuccino.
archival_memory.pricing_and_promotions: Our espresso machines range in price from around $200 to over $1,000, depending on the model and features. As for discounts and promotions, we do offer a 'New Customer Discount' for first-time buyers. It typically ranges from 5% to 15% off select items. We also have bundle deals and limited-time promotions that can provide additional savings. If you're interested in specific pricing or current promotions, I can help you with that.
archival_memory.shipping_info: Shipping from Seattle typically takes 1-3 business days. For items shipped from out-of-state, delivery times can range from 3 to 7 business days, depending on location and weather conditions.
archival_memory.customer_support: We pride ourselves on providing excellent customer support. Our team is dedicated to helping you find the perfect product for your needs. We're here to answer any questions you have, from the features and functionality of our products to the ease of cleaning and maintenance. We want to ensure that your coffee machine perfectly aligns with your routine and preferences.
archival_memory.product_dimensions:
Here are the typical dimensions for our espresso machines:

- Single-serve espresso machines: 12-15 inches in width, 8-12 inches in depth, and 12-15 inches in height.
- Double-serve espresso machines: 15-18 inches in width, 12-15 inches in depth, and 15-18 inches in height.
- Super-automatic espresso machines: 18-22 inches in width, 15-18 inches in depth, and 18-22 inches in height.

These dimensions can help you gauge the space required for your new espresso machine. If you have any specific models in mind, I can provide more detailed information.
archival_memory.warranty_info: Yes, our coffee machines come with a warranty. Typically, our standard warranty ranges from 1 to 2 years, depending on the model. Higher-end models often have extended warranties of up to 3 years or more. We also offer dedicated customer service and a comprehensive support system to ensure that any issues are addressed promptly and efficiently. If you have any specific concerns or questions about our warranty, feel free to ask.
archival_memory.temperature_control: Yes, many of our espresso machines have adjustable temperature settings, allowing you to customize the brewing temperature to your liking. Additionally, our drip coffee makers are designed to produce hot coffee, with most models featuring automatic temperature control to ensure a consistent brewing temperature. If you have a specific model in mind, I can provide more detailed information on its temperature features.
